display_name: Record that a host session closed
description: A host tells the solet that its session closed, by host kind (tmux or headless) and the exact host session reference. Every live managed-session record that names that host session is checked once by exact host reference. A record whose host session is gone is terminated with the reason 'ended: <host> reported host session <ref> closed; <what the check observed>', its host liveness is recorded dead, and its armed session_terminal edges fire. A record whose host session still exists is left as it is. A record whose host session cannot be checked is left exactly as it is and listed with the reason. The notice is a trigger, never proof: only the exact check ends a record. Any caller may send it; nothing here names a project or a session.
embedding_description: Tell the solet that a tmux or headless host session closed so the records naming it end once an exact check confirms the host session is gone, and records that cannot be checked stay unchanged and are counted.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: host and host_ref echo the notice. checked is the number of live records that named that host session. ended lists the agent_instance_ids this call terminated, in record order. present lists the records left live because the host session exists. unknown lists records left exactly as they were because the host session could not be checked, each with agent_instance_id and detail (the check's own message). changed_meanwhile lists records that changed between the read and the write; nothing was written for them.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report ended, present and unknown as separate counts. Say plainly that a record in unknown was not ended and why, quoting its detail; unknown is not ended. A record in present is left because the exact check found its host session. Zero checked means no live record names that host session, which is not an error.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: If unknown is not empty, the notice could not be confirmed for those records; they stay as they are until another notice, a start-time check or the session's own report ends them.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One read of the live records that name the host session, then for each gone record a predicated lifecycle write under the exact snapshot that was read, an audit row, and the firing of armed session_terminal edges.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: host is not tmux or headless, or host_ref is missing or blank. state_service_unavailable: the solet's state service is not bound. A lost race on a record is not an error; it is listed in changed_meanwhile.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For parameter_invalid, send host as tmux or headless and the exact host session reference. For state_service_unavailable, retry once the solet is fully started.
